# PHANTOMX MVP PR Contract

Every PR must identify exactly one atomic task.

Required evidence:
- objective and dependency
- files changed
- deterministic tests
- adversarial/regression tests where applicable
- economic assumptions and exact cost inputs
- security implications
- state/gate transition
- known limitations
- rollback/recovery notes

Never mark a PR as proving realized profit unless a transaction receipt and independent wallet reconciliation are attached as evidence.

No live-capital enablement may be introduced by ordinary feature PRs.
